style_guide: Premium dark theme (near-black background like #0a0a0f, subtle gradient accents, one accent color), modern sans-serif font (Google Fonts: Inter, Poppins or Space Grotesk), smooth scroll-linked animations (parallax / elements sliding with scroll, not just fade-in), mobile-first responsive, all visible text in English only, small 'made by doomsage' footer at the bottom unless the user asks to skip it. No external image URLs; use CSS gradients, shapes and emoji/SVG instead.
